name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Improve the transcript tool’s retry logic for failed YouTube IDs. Engineering owns the tool, so they should implement exponential backoff with a max of 3 retries per ID. This cuts manual rework by catching transient errors without overloading YouTube’s API, accepting the trade-off of slightly slower processing for fewer false negatives.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s retry logic ignores the real risk: YouTube’s quota resets at midnight UTC, so exponential backoff can still exhaust daily limits before the reset. Instead, batch retries by quota window and surface a daily “quota exhausted” flag to Product—this trades immediate speed for predictable throughput. Settle it by running a 7-day quota simulation with YouTube’s public limits.
